description: This Java class provides services for integrating with CyberSource payment gateway, including authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit operations. It constructs requests, handles responses, and manages configuration settings for CyberSource transactions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: IcsPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling CyberSource payment operations such as authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization with CyberSource, constructs request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Stub method for re-authorization, currently returns success.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured transaction.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Credits (refunds) a transaction, typically for a full or partial refund.

methods.name: buildCsProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for CyberSource client based on payment gateway settings.

methods.name: buildAuthRequest
methods.description: Constructs the authorization request map with billing, item, and AVS info.

methods.name: buildCaptureRequest
methods.description: Constructs the capture request map with transaction details.

methods.name: buildReleaseRequest
methods.description: Constructs the release (void) request map.

methods.name: buildRefundRequest
methods.description: Constructs the refund request map.

methods.name: buildCreditRequest
methods.description: Constructs the credit (refund) request map.

methods.name: appendAvsRules
methods.description: Adds AVS decline rules to the request based on configuration.

methods.name: appendFullBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing, shipping, and credit card info to the request.

methods.name: appendItemLineInfo
methods.description: Adds line item details to the request.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats amount as string with proper scale and rounding.

methods.name: processAuthResult
methods.description: Processes the response of an authorization request.

methods.name: processCaptureResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a capture request.

methods.name: processReleaseResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a release (void) request.

methods.name: processRefundResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a refund request.

methods.name: processCreditResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a credit (refund) request.

methods.name: getDecision
methods.description: Extracts decision status from CyberSource reply.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for CyberSource from either entity or properties.
